subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Number symbols and number names
source.subtopic: Write number symbols and number names to 20

show.line: Numbers have names in words. Eleven, twelve, thirteen. Let's match the word to the number!

rounds.prompt: Tap the word that says twelve.
Read this number word to me.
Which number matches the word eighteen?
Read this number word to me.
Tap the word that says eleven.
Write sixteen with your finger. A one, then a six.
Match the word to its number. Is it thirteen or fourteen?

hints: Teen words end in teen. Look at the start of the word.
Sound out the first part. Fif, teen. Fifteen.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this number word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That word says twenty. Twelve ends in elve.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. Twen, ty. Twenty!

parent_line: Can read the number words to twenty and match them to numerals.
